The 700+ five-star reviews behind Live Junk Free repeat one detail more than any other: the price never changed because of how far down the road the property sat.

items.q: How much does demolition cost in Caledon?

items.q: Can one booking really clear several structures on a farm property?
a: Yes — that’s a common Caledon job. The walkthrough scopes every structure that’s coming down, prices it as one job, and the crew sequences the work across the whole property in a single visit.

items.q: Can the good wood or hardware from a fence or shed be saved?
a: Often, yes — say so at the walkthrough. Fence boards, deck lumber and hardware worth keeping come out intact and set aside before the rest is hauled, sorted at no extra charge.

items.q: Do rural addresses or long laneways cost extra?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at Caledon East’s village core and eight concessions past it.

items.q: Can you take down paddock fencing without disturbing our animals?
